Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (Affinity Purification Mass Spectrometry) to identify interacting partners of KCTD7 and CLN5. Acquisition was DDA on an Orbitrap Fusion Lumos. No stable isotope labeling was described, indicating a label-free approach.

scope: we combined CRISPR-Cas9–mediated gene tagging and affinity purification followed by mass spectrometry (AP-MS) to identify potential KCTD7-interacting partners
KCTD7 protein complexes were purified and identified by AP-MS.
the WCLs were incubated with anti-FLAG antibody-conjugated M2 agarose beads (Sigma-Aldrich) at 4°C overnight to capture FLAG-tagged KCTD7.
Overexpressed CLN5 were tagged by FLAG and then purified by TAP with FLAG M2 beads. Then the product is sbujected to MS to ananlyze the interaction proteins with CLN5.
